annotations.title: Check a container or B/L number

description: Use when a user wants to track a container, bill of lading or booking number, or to know whether a container number is valid. Check a shipping container number (ISO 6346 check digit), find who owns its prefix (shipping line or container leasing company, e.g. MSCU = MSC, TGHU = Textainer) and get the line's official tracking page. Bill of lading numbers are recognised by the carrier's B/L prefix, usually its SCAC (e.g. HLCU, COSU; MSC uses MEDU, while its SCAC is MSCU). Does not return live status: the line's own site shows it.

number.description: Container number, e.g. 'MSCU1234566' (4 letters + 7 digits), or a bill of lading / booking number, e.g. 'MEDUAB123456'
